title: Badge Required
description:
Guestbook’s controller was using a ServiceAccount that could almost anything. Security revoked the badge.

Give the workload a dedicated ServiceAccount bound with only the verbs and resources it needs. Over-broad ClusterRoles fail the audit even if “it works.”

**Meant for:** ServiceAccount + Role/RoleBinding.

problemStatement.brief: Give Guestbook a dedicated ServiceAccount with only the verbs/resources it needs — over-broad ClusterRoles fail.
